name: Mugging

text.trigger: A player controls a survivor who is not exiled and stands at the same location as an exiled survivor.
text.vignette: A hard hand shoves you into a doorframe and a low voice by your ear says all it wants is your gear, and that a corpse is just as easy to rob. The voice sounds like someone who used to share a fire with you.

options.hand-it-over: Pay up: hand over your whole hand except 1 card of your choice to whoever controls the exiled survivor.
options.fight-back: Fight back: one of your survivors there takes 2 wounds; but with a weapon at hand you can kill the exiled attacker and take just 1 wound.

notes: src: Crossroad_cards_v1.1.xlsx.txt card #11; Needs an exiled player, so it is left out of the co-op variant. "If you have a weapon" counts a weapon card in your hand or equipped to one of your survivors.
